answer: Proposal: stake-backed vouching with bounded fan-out. A key earns only after a funded identity endorses it with a slashable bond; each identity vouches for at most two newcomers per epoch. An attacker can forge keys and tint each in fresh pigment, yet unvouched keys earn nothing; trust accretes in slow layers like a crystal. Fast growth requires buying vouches from independent holders who risk their own stake; self-vouching stacks the farm's capital into one slashable pyramid. Assumes fraud proofs and an audited seed set. Limit: honest clusters are only rate-limited, not slashed.
